sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write simple sentences with a variety of new vocabulary, verbs and adjectives.
sla_notes_details: A checklist for written sentences: (1) subject present, (2) verb in place, (3) correct word order, (4) measure word and number, (5) 的 where needed, (6) punctuation. Exercises: rearrange word cards into sentences (我 / 在 / 学习 / 汉语 → 我在学习汉语), fill gaps, complete sentences and write from a picture. Adverbs come before the verb: 他们都去 (they all go). Games and activities such as 'sentence race' consolidate accuracy.
sla_notes_illustrations: Word cards: 弟弟 / 每天 / 踢 / 足球 → 弟弟每天踢足球。Dìdi měitiān tī zúqiú. (My little brother plays football every day.) Learner writes this in characters and pinyin.
sla_notes_daily_life: Correct written sentences are the basis of essays, letters and exam writing in Chinese.
sla_exercise: Arrange: 汉语 / 我 / 学习 / 在::我在学习汉语。Wǒ zài xuéxí Hànyǔ.||Where does an adverb such as 都 go in the sentence?::Before the verb.||Translate 弟弟每天踢足球。::My younger brother plays football every day.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to listen and understand information
learning_activity_name: Participate in a simple conversation in different communicative settings
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple conversation in different communicative settings are participated in.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners take part in simple conversations in settings such as school, home, the street and the market.
sla_notes_details: Every conversation has an opening, a body and a closing. Opening: 你好, 请问... Body: questions and answers. Closing: 谢谢, 再见. Useful settings: introducing a friend (这是我的朋友 zhè shì wǒ de péngyou), asking directions (请问,邮局在哪儿? qǐngwèn, yóujú zài nǎr?), making a request (请帮我 qǐng bāng wǒ), and small talk about the weather (今天天气很好 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo). Learners repeat what they hear before responding and use role play to practise.
sla_notes_illustrations: Role play on the street. A: 请问,邮局在哪儿? Qǐngwèn, yóujú zài nǎr? B: 邮局在学校后边。Yóujú zài xuéxiào hòubian. A: 谢谢! B: 不客气!
sla_notes_daily_life: Handling different conversational settings prepares learners to communicate in real situations with tourists, business people and friends.
sla_exercise: How do you ask 'Where is the post office?'::邮局在哪儿? (yóujú zài nǎr?)||Translate 这是我的朋友。::This is my friend.||Name the three parts of a conversation.::Opening, body and closing.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to listen and understand information
learning_activity_name: Listen to a simple text and identify new words used in it
sla_name: Listening to a text and identifying new words
sla_assessment_criteria: New words used in a simple text are listened and identified.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to a short text and pick out new words, then write and explain them.
sla_notes_details: Steps: listen for the topic, listen again to note unfamiliar words, write them in pinyin, guess the meaning from context, check with the teacher or dictionary. Learners note the parts of speech and try to use the words in new sentences. Contextual learning makes new words easier to remember: link each word to a picture, action or situation. Text example: 我的爷爷是农民。他每天早上去农场工作。Wǒ de yéye shì nóngmín. Tā měitiān zǎoshang qù nóngchǎng gōngzuò. New words: 农民 nóngmín (farmer), 农场 nóngchǎng (farm), 工作 gōngzuò (work).
sla_notes_illustrations: After listening, the learner records 农民 nóngmín – farmer, 农场 nóngchǎng – farm, 工作 gōngzuò – work, and makes the sentence 我的姐姐在医院工作。Wǒ de jiějie zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
sla_notes_daily_life: Picking up new words from listening lets learners expand vocabulary from radio, video and daily contact with speakers.
sla_exercise: What does 农民 mean?::Farmer.||Translate 他在农场工作。::He works on a farm.||Why is it useful to link a new word to a picture or action?::It helps learners remember the meaning in context.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to read and understand various texts
learning_activity_name: Read a simple text and summarise the main ideas from it
sla_name: Summarising the main ideas of a text
sla_assessment_criteria: Main ideas from simple text are read and summarized.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read a simple text and state its main ideas in a few sentences.
sla_notes_details: Steps for summarising: read the text; underline key words; find the main idea of each paragraph; leave out details and examples; write the summary in your own words in 2 to 4 sentences. Question prompts: 谁? 在哪儿? 做什么? 为什么? Songs and dictogloss also help learners practise picking main ideas. Example text: 小李的家在乡下。他家有一个大农场。他爸爸每天在农场工作,妈妈在家做饭。 Summary: 小李的家在乡下,爸爸在农场工作。
sla_notes_illustrations: Text (four sentences) about a market day. Summary: 星期六,大家去市场买菜。市场里人很多。Xīngqīliù, dàjiā qù shìchǎng mǎi cài. Shìchǎng lǐ rén hěn duō. (On Saturday everybody goes to the market to buy vegetables. There are many people.)
sla_notes_daily_life: Summarising helps learners handle large amounts of information in reading, reporting to others and studying.
sla_exercise: What should a good summary leave out?::Small details and examples.||Translate 乡下.::Countryside (village).||How many sentences is a short summary?::About two to four sentences.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to read and understand various texts
learning_activity_name: Read a simple story and re-tell it using own words
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple story are read and re-told using own words.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read a simple story and retell it in their own words.
sla_notes_details: To retell: read for the main events, list them in order with sequence words (首先, 然后, 后来, 最后), then tell the story without looking at the text. A retelling has characters, place, events and an ending. Simple past narration in Chinese uses 了 for completed actions and time words: 昨天 zuótiān (yesterday), 上午 shàngwǔ (morning). Learners can retell with pictures as prompts, and pair-check details.
sla_notes_illustrations: Story: 昨天,我和弟弟去市场。我们买了鱼和菜,然后回家。 Retell: 昨天我和弟弟去市场买了鱼和菜,最后我们回家了。Zuótiān wǒ hé dìdi qù shìchǎng mǎi le yú hé cài, zuìhòu wǒmen huí jiā le.
sla_notes_daily_life: Retelling helps learners share news, explain events and pass on stories in Chinese.
sla_exercise: What word means 'yesterday'?::昨天 (zuótiān).||Which particle shows a completed action?::了 (le).||Name two sequence words used in retelling.::For example 首先 (first) and 最后 (finally).

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Show the right response in various communicative contexts
learning_activity_name: Listen and respond to complex orders in a market setting
sla_name: Responding to complex orders in a market
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex orders in a market setting are listened and responded.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to longer orders given in a market and carry them out correctly.
sla_notes_details: Market orders combine goods, quantities and actions: 请给我三个苹果,两斤鱼 qǐng gěi wǒ sān gè píngguǒ, liǎng jīn yú (please give me three apples and two jin of fish), 请把这些菜放进袋子里 qǐng bǎ zhèxiē cài fàng jìn dàizi lǐ (please put these vegetables into the bag). Useful verbs: 拿 ná (take), 称 chēng (weigh), 包 bāo (wrap), 找钱 zhǎo qián (give change). Learners listen to a recorded speech, write the list of goods and quantities, and then act it out as shop assistants.
sla_notes_illustrations: Audio order: 请给我两斤西红柿,三个香蕉,还要一条鱼。Qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng jīn xīhóngshì, sān gè xiāngjiāo, hái yào yì tiáo yú. Learner writes: tomatoes 2 jin, bananas 3, fish 1.
sla_notes_daily_life: Understanding orders is needed for shop assistants, customers and people who work in restaurants and markets.
sla_exercise: Translate 请给我三个苹果。::Please give me three apples.||What is 找钱?::To give change.||What does 还要 mean?::Also want (want in addition).

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Show the right response in various communicative contexts
learning_activity_name: Read different posters in the market and react accordingly
sla_assessment_criteria: Different posters in the market are read and reacted accordingly.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read posters and notices in a market and respond correctly, for example by choosing a product or price.
sla_notes_details: Poster vocabulary: 欢迎光临 huānyíng guānglín (welcome), 特价 tèjià (special price), 打折 dǎzhé (discount), 免费 miǎnfèi (free), 新鲜 xīnxiān (fresh), 营业时间 yíngyè shíjiān (opening hours), 出口 chūkǒu (exit), 入口 rùkǒu (entrance), 禁止 jìnzhǐ (prohibited), 请勿吸烟 qǐng wù xīyān (no smoking). Prices are written with numerals: ¥5.00. Reading tips: read the heading, find the price, find the item, decide. Reading aloud helps learners practise pronunciation.
sla_notes_illustrations: Poster: 新鲜香蕉,特价!每斤五块。 Xīnxiān xiāngjiāo, tèjià! Měi jīn wǔ kuài. (Fresh bananas, special price! Five yuan per jin.) The learner says how much for two jin: 十块 (ten yuan).
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading signs and posters helps when shopping or travelling in Chinese-speaking areas and when working with Chinese products.
sla_exercise: What does 特价 mean?::Special price.||What does the sign 出口 indicate?::Exit.||If bananas cost five yuan per jin, what do two jin cost?::Ten yuan (十块).

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to read correctly various texts
learning_activity_name: Read accurately complex sentences using standard speed, correct tone, pronunciation and punctuation marks
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex sentences using standard speed, correct tone, pronunciation and punctuation marks are read accurately.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read longer sentences aloud accurately, at standard speed, with correct tone, pronunciation and punctuation.
sla_notes_details: In a complex sentence the parts are joined by link words: 因为...所以..., 虽然...但是..., 如果...就..., 不但...而且.... Punctuation guides reading: pause at ， (short), 、 (very short), ； (medium), 。 (long). Learners find the link words and the verbs, read once silently, then aloud. Role-playing practice with dialogue containing complex sentences helps intonation. Example: 虽然天气很热,但是学生们都去上学了。Suīrán tiānqì hěn rè, dànshì xuéshengmen dōu qù shàngxué le.
sla_notes_illustrations: The learner reads 如果明天不下雨,我们就去市场。Rúguǒ míngtiān bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù shìchǎng. (If it does not rain tomorrow, we will go to the market.) The teacher notes the pause after the comma and the fourth-tone change to bú before xià.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading complex sentences aloud fluently prepares learners for reading news, stories and presentations.
sla_exercise: What does 如果...就... mean?::If ... then ...||What does 虽然...但是... express?::Although ... yet/but ...||Why is 不 pronounced bú in 不下雨?::Because 下 is a fourth-tone syllable.

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in a variety of contexts
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to communicate orally
learning_activity_name: Read aloud simple sentences in various contexts
sla_name: Reading simple sentences aloud in different contexts
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple sentences in various contexts are read aloud.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read simple sentences with feeling and correct tone in different situations such as announcements, dialogues and stories.
sla_notes_details: Different contexts affect voice: an announcement is loud, clear and slow; a dialogue is natural; a story has expression. Learners mark stress and pauses on the text, then read. Gallery work: sentences about traffic signs and safety are posted around the room and learners read them aloud at each station. Examples: 请走人行道 qǐng zǒu rénxíngdào (please use the pavement), 红灯停,绿灯行 hóngdēng tíng, lǜdēng xíng (red light stop, green light go).
sla_notes_illustrations: Gallery. Station 1: 红灯停。Hóngdēng tíng. Station 2: 绿灯行。Lǜdēng xíng. Station 3: 请过马路看车。Qǐng guò mǎlù kàn chē. Learners read each sentence aloud and explain its meaning.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading aloud in different contexts prepares learners for presentations, announcements and road-safety education.
sla_exercise: What does 红灯停 mean?::Stop at the red light.||Translate 请走人行道。::Please walk on the pavement.||How should an announcement be read?::Loud, clear and at a steady, slower speed.

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in a variety of contexts
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to communicate orally
learning_activity_name: Participate in a conversation about family relationships and occupations
sla_name: Conversation about family relationships and occupations
sla_assessment_criteria: Conversation about family relationships and occupations are participated in.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners ask and answer about family relationships and jobs.
sla_notes_details: Relationships: 父母 fùmǔ (parents), 兄弟姐妹 xiōngdì jiěmèi (siblings), 叔叔 shūshu (uncle), 阿姨 āyí (aunt), 表哥 biǎogē (cousin). Occupations: 老师 lǎoshī, 医生 yīshēng, 护士 hùshi (nurse), 农民 nóngmín, 司机 sījī (driver), 工程师 gōngchéngshī (engineer), 商人 shāngrén (businessperson), 警察 jǐngchá (police officer). Questions: 你爸爸做什么工作? nǐ bàba zuò shénme gōngzuò? (what does your father do?) — 他是司机。Tā shì sījī. Sentence patterns use 在...工作 (work at ...) and 是 for identity. Speech and debate are used to present the occupations learners would like.
sla_notes_illustrations: Dialogue. A: 你爸爸做什么工作? B: 他是医生,在医院工作。Tā shì yīshēng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò. A: 你妈妈呢? B: 她是老师,在学校工作。Tā shì lǎoshī, zài xuéxiào gōngzuò.
sla_notes_daily_life: Talking about jobs and family is very common in conversations with new acquaintances and helps learners discuss their career plans.
sla_exercise: How do you ask 'What does your father do?'::你爸爸做什么工作? (nǐ bàba zuò shénme gōngzuò?)||What is 护士 in English?::Nurse.||Translate 她是老师,在学校工作。::She is a teacher and works at school.

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in a variety of contexts
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to communicate accurately in writing in various contexts
learning_activity_name: Write simple guided paragraphs using appropriate punctuation marks
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple guided paragraphs using appropriate punctuation marks are written.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write a short paragraph guided by a model or by questions, using correct punctuation.
sla_notes_details: A guided paragraph has a topic sentence, two or three supporting sentences and a closing sentence. Cohesive devices: 首先, 然后, 最后; 也 (also), 还 (in addition), 因为...所以.... Punctuation: commas after time words and between clauses, full stops at the end. Learners plan with a mind map, write in characters with tianzige, then proofread punctuation, tones in pinyin and characters. Model: 我的家 (My family). Sentence starters: 我家有...口人。我爸爸是...。我妈妈是...。我喜欢...。
sla_notes_illustrations: Guided paragraph. 我家有五口人:爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。爸爸是农民,妈妈是老师。我是学生。我爱我的家。Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén: bàba, māma, gēge, mèimei hé wǒ. Bàba shì nóngmín, māma shì lǎoshī. Wǒ shì xuésheng. Wǒ ài wǒ de jiā.
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing short paragraphs prepares learners to write letters, self-introductions and diary entries in Chinese.
sla_exercise: What are the parts of a paragraph?::A topic sentence, supporting sentences and a closing sentence.||Which punctuation mark separates the family members in the model paragraph?::The enumeration comma 、.||Translate 我爱我的家。::I love my family.

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and accurate translation
learning_activity_name: Translate complex sentences
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex sentences are translated.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners translate complex sentences between Chinese and English (or Kiswahili), keeping the meaning correct and natural.
sla_notes_details: Translation is not word-for-word. Steps: read and understand the whole sentence; find the structure (link words, subject, verb); translate meaning unit by unit; rewrite it naturally in the target language; check. Chinese has no verb tenses, so time is shown by time words and 了; word order of modifiers comes before the noun (我昨天买的书 wǒ zuótiān mǎi de shū, the book that I bought yesterday). Translation games and activities practise structures and vocabulary. Example: 虽然他很忙,但是他每天都学习汉语。 → Although he is very busy, he studies Chinese every day.
sla_notes_illustrations: Translate: Because it was raining, we stayed at home. → 因为下雨,所以我们在家。Yīnwèi xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen zài jiā. The learner explains that 因为 and 所以 are both used in Chinese although only one word is needed in English.
sla_notes_daily_life: Translation skills are valuable in tourism, trade and communication with Chinese-speaking partners.
sla_exercise: Translate: Although it is hot, we play football.::虽然天气很热,但是我们踢足球。||Why is translation not done word for word?::Word order and grammar differ between languages, so the meaning must be rendered naturally.||What shows the time of an action in Chinese, since there are no verb tenses?::Time words and the particle 了.

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and accurate translation
learning_activity_name: Translate simple texts
sla_method: Listen and translate what you hear
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple texts are translated.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners translate short texts of a few sentences between Chinese and English (or Kiswahili).
sla_notes_details: A text is translated paragraph by paragraph. Steps: skim for topic, list unknown words, translate sentence by sentence, keep names, numbers and dates accurate, read the whole translation and revise. Names of people are transcribed by sound or kept in pinyin; place names such as 坦桑尼亚 Tǎnsāngníyà (Tanzania) and 中国 Zhōngguó (China) have fixed Chinese forms. Dates are written in the order year, month, day: 2025年3月8日. Listen-and-translate tasks use audio texts. Example text: 我叫汤姆。我十五岁。我是坦桑尼亚人。
sla_notes_illustrations: Translate: 我叫汤姆。我十五岁。我是坦桑尼亚人。我喜欢汉语。 → My name is Tom. I am fifteen. I am Tanzanian. I like Chinese.
sla_notes_daily_life: Translating short texts helps learners with signs, forms, product instructions and short messages.
sla_exercise: Write in Chinese: 'Tanzania'.::坦桑尼亚 (Tǎnsāngníyà).||In which order are dates written in Chinese?::Year, month, day.||Translate 我十五岁。::I am fifteen years old.

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and accurate translation
learning_activity_name: Translate simple sentences
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple sentences are translated.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners translate simple sentences between Chinese and English (or Kiswahili) accurately.
sla_notes_details: Simple sentences follow Subject + Verb + Object. Translate sentence by sentence: identify the subject, the verb and the object, then rewrite. Points of contrast: Chinese does not use articles (a, the); the copula 是 is not used before adjectives (她很漂亮, not 她是漂亮); questions use 吗 and 呢 without changing word order; negatives use 不 (habit or present) and 没 (past or have). Games and dialogues such as 'say it in Chinese' help practise translation.
sla_notes_illustrations: Translate: The teacher is in the classroom. → 老师在教室。Lǎoshī zài jiàoshì. Translate: 我没有哥哥。→ I do not have an elder brother. Translate: 他们不是学生。→ They are not students.
sla_notes_daily_life: Simple sentence translation is used in everyday situations such as helping visitors or asking for help in another language.
sla_exercise: Translate: I have two books.::我有两本书。Wǒ yǒu liǎng běn shū.||Does Chinese use articles like 'a' and 'the'?::No, Chinese has no articles.||Translate 她很漂亮。::She is beautiful.

specific_competence_name: Develop awareness of Chinese phonemes, initial, final, tone and characters
learning_activity_name: Read Chinese words in pinyin while observing appropriate sequencing of tones
sla_name: Reading pinyin with correct tone sequences
sla_assessment_criteria: Chinese words in pinyin are read while observing appropriate sequencing of tones.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read Chinese words and short phrases in pinyin aloud, applying tone sequences and tone changes correctly.
sla_notes_details: Reading aloud in pinyin means recognising the tone marks, applying sandhi rules and keeping natural rhythm. Rules recalled: third tone + third tone (the first becomes tone 2), 不 (bù → bú before tone 4), 一 (yī → yí before tone 4; yì before tones 1, 2, 3), and the neutral tone in particles and reduplicated kinship words. Learners read tongue twisters to improve fluency, for example 四是四,十是十 sì shì sì, shí shì shí (four is four, ten is ten). Reading aloud with unfamiliar words also builds confidence: learners identify unfamiliar words and ask about them.
sla_notes_illustrations: The learner reads: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, bú shì qī diǎn. Then reads the tongue twister Sì shì sì, shí shì shí, shísì shì shísì, sìshí shì sìshí, marking the contrast between the retroflex sh and the plain s.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading pinyin fluently supports texting with a pinyin keyboard, using dictionaries and learning new words from textbooks and apps.
sla_exercise: How is 一起 read in pinyin, with the tone change?::yìqǐ.||What is the tongue twister 四是四,十是十 meant to train?::The contrast between s and sh and the second and fourth tones.||How is 不对 pronounced?::bú duì.

specific_competence_name: Develop awareness of Chinese phonemes, initial, final, tone and characters
learning_activity_name: Write Chinese words in pinyin while observing appropriate sequencing of tones
sla_name: Writing pinyin with correct tone sequences
sla_assessment_criteria: Chinese words in pinyin are written while observing appropriate sequencing of tones.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write pinyin for Chinese sentences and record tone changes accurately in their writing.
sla_notes_details: In official pinyin spelling the tone marks show the base tone of the word. Whether to write the changed tone is a convention: textbooks normally write 不 as bù or bú according to pronunciation (bú shì) and 一 as yī, yí or yì according to pronunciation, but write third-tone pairs with the original marks (nǐ hǎo). Learners write by note taking from a spoken text and by debating in writing which tone applies. Words are joined by word (xuéxí, not xué xí) and sentences begin with capital letters. Proper nouns are capitalised.
sla_notes_illustrations: Dictation. The teacher says 你今天不去学校吗? and the learner writes Nǐ jīntiān bú qù xuéxiào ma? The learner underlines bú and explains that qù is a fourth-tone syllable.
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing accurate pinyin helps learners type Chinese and label names and addresses correctly.
sla_exercise: Write 不是 in pinyin, showing the actual tone.::bú shì.||Why do we write xuéxí as one word?::Because pinyin is written by words, not by single syllables.||Which letter starts a sentence in pinyin?::A capital letter.

specific_competence_name: Develop awareness of Chinese phonemes, initial, final, tone and characters
learning_activity_name: Write Chinese characters with 16-17 strokes
sla_name: Writing Chinese characters of 16 to 17 strokes
sla_method: Tianzige methods and Games and activities
sla_assessment_criteria: Chinese characters with 16-17 strokes are written.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write complex characters of sixteen and seventeen strokes, applying the rules of order and balance.
sla_notes_details: Characters with 16 strokes include 整 zhěng (whole, tidy), 餐 cān (meal), 镜 jìng (mirror, as in 眼镜 yǎnjìng, glasses), 操 cāo (exercise, as in 操场 cāochǎng, playground) and 器 qì (device, as in 电器 diànqì, electrical appliance). The character 戴 dài (to wear) has 17 strokes. Learners use the tianzige method: write the character in a grid with several lines so that the strokes are well distributed. Complex characters are split into components and written part by part, for example 整 = 敕 + 正 and 镜 = 钅 + 竟. Games and activities such as timed writing relays consolidate learning.
sla_notes_illustrations: Learner writes 整 (16 strokes) in a tianzige: 敕 (upper part, 11 strokes) and 正 (5 strokes), total sixteen. Then writes 整理 zhěnglǐ (to tidy up) and 整个 zhěnggè (whole).
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing these characters supports reading menus (餐厅 cāntīng, restaurant), sport (操场) and everyday objects (眼镜, glasses).
sla_exercise: How many strokes does 整 have?::Sixteen strokes.||Give a Chinese word using 餐 and its meaning.::餐厅 (cāntīng), restaurant.||What does 戴 mean?::To wear (for example glasses or a hat).

specific_competence_name: Master the correct Chinese vocabulary in various contexts
learning_activity_name: Write new words associated with the hospital environment
sla_method: Note taking and Writing Practice Sheets
sla_assessment_criteria: New words associated with the hospital environment are written.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded texts with lists of vocabulary|Written materials
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write vocabulary about hospitals, illness and treatment.
sla_notes_details: Vocabulary: 医院 yīyuàn (hospital), 医生 yīshēng (doctor), 护士 hùshi (nurse), 病人 bìngrén (patient), 药 yào (medicine), 药房 yàofáng (pharmacy), 挂号 guàhào (register), 检查 jiǎnchá (examination), 打针 dǎzhēn (injection), 发烧 fāshāo (fever), 咳嗽 késou (cough), 头疼 tóu téng (headache), 肚子疼 dùzi téng (stomach ache), 感冒 gǎnmào (cold, flu), 急诊 jízhěn (emergency). Learners write a word bank with pinyin and English, and note-take from an audio speech about a hospital visit. The doctor's typical questions are 你哪儿不舒服? nǐ nǎr bù shūfu? (what is wrong?)
sla_notes_illustrations: Word list. Learners write: 医院 yīyuàn – hospital; 药 yào – medicine; 发烧 fāshāo – fever; 头疼 tóu téng – headache; and label a hospital plan with 挂号处 guàhào chù (registration), 药房 yàofáng, 急诊室 jízhěnshì.
sla_notes_daily_life: Medical vocabulary is important when helping Chinese-speaking visitors who are ill or working as an interpreter in health services.
sla_exercise: Write 'hospital' in Chinese and pinyin.::医院, yīyuàn.||What is 头疼?::Headache.||How does a doctor ask 'What is wrong with you?'::你哪儿不舒服? (nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?)

specific_competence_name: Master the correct Chinese vocabulary in various contexts
learning_activity_name: Construct simple oral sentences using new words associated with the hospital environment
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple oral sentences using new words associated with the hospital environment are constructed.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded texts with lists of vocabulary|Written materials
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners make oral sentences with hospital words, describing symptoms and giving simple advice.
sla_notes_details: Patterns: 我...疼 wǒ ... téng (my ... hurts), 我发烧了 wǒ fāshāo le (I have a fever), 我咳嗽两天了 wǒ késou liǎng tiān le (I have coughed for two days), 你应该... nǐ yīnggāi ... (you should ...), 多喝水 duō hē shuǐ (drink plenty of water), 好好休息 hǎohǎo xiūxi (rest well). Dictation and listening exercises help learners recall the words before speaking. Doctor-patient role play uses complete sentences.
sla_notes_illustrations: Role play. Doctor: 你哪儿不舒服? Patient: 我头疼,还发烧。Wǒ tóu téng, hái fāshāo. Doctor: 你应该吃药,多喝水,好好休息。Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō hē shuǐ, hǎohǎo xiūxi.
sla_notes_daily_life: Describing symptoms lets learners explain how they feel and understand medical advice.
sla_exercise: Translate 我头疼。::I have a headache.||How do you say 'You should rest' in Chinese?::你应该休息 (nǐ yīnggāi xiūxi).||What does 多喝水 mean?::Drink plenty of water.

specific_competence_name: Master the correct Chinese vocabulary in various contexts
learning_activity_name: Write simple sentences using new words associated with the hospital environment
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple sentences using new words associated with the hospital environment are written.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded texts with lists of vocabulary|Written materials
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write sentences about a visit to a hospital, symptoms and treatment.
sla_notes_details: Written sentences use time words and the particle 了: 昨天我发烧了 zuótiān wǒ fāshāo le (yesterday I had a fever), 医生给我开了药 yīshēng gěi wǒ kāi le yào (the doctor prescribed medicine for me). Prescriptions include frequency and timing: 一天三次,每次一片 yì tiān sān cì, měi cì yí piàn (three times a day, one tablet each time), 饭后吃 fàn hòu chī (take after meals). Writing practice sheets guide learners to use characters accurately, with the right measure words (一片药 yí piàn yào, 一瓶水 yì píng shuǐ).
sla_notes_illustrations: Learner writes: 我昨天不舒服,所以去了医院。医生说我感冒了。他给我开了药。Wǒ zuótiān bù shūfu, suǒyǐ qù le yīyuàn. Yīshēng shuō wǒ gǎnmào le. Tā gěi wǒ kāi le yào.
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing about health matters helps in filling forms, writing messages to a doctor or reporting an illness.
sla_exercise: Write 'take medicine three times a day' in Chinese.::一天吃三次药 (yì tiān chī sān cì yào).||What does 饭后吃 mean?::Take after meals.||What is the measure word for a tablet?::片 (piàn).

sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to complex sentences with several clauses and respond in a suitable way.
sla_notes_details: Common complex structures: 虽然...但是... (although ... but ...), 因为...所以... (because ... so ...), 如果...就... (if ... then ...), 不但...而且... (not only ... but also ...), 一边...一边... (do two things at once), 先...再...(first ... then ...). Learners listen for the link words, work out the relationship between clauses and answer. Reading aloud and repeating build accuracy. Example: 虽然他病了,但是他还去上学。Suīrán tā bìng le, dànshì tā hái qù shàngxué. Response: 他应该在家休息。Tā yīnggāi zài jiā xiūxi.
sla_notes_illustrations: Audio: 不但医生很热情,而且护士也很热情。Bùdàn yīshēng hěn rèqíng, érqiě hùshi yě hěn rèqíng. Question: 谁很热情? Answer: 医生和护士都很热情。
sla_notes_daily_life: Following complex sentences is necessary to understand news, explanations and real conversations.
sla_exercise: What does 不但...而且... mean?::Not only ... but also ...||Translate 一边吃饭一边看电视。::Eat while watching TV.||Which word means 'although' in 虽然...但是...?::虽然 (suīrán).

sla_assessment_criteria: Complex oral sentences are constructed by using different words.

sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners use different words and link words to build complex spoken sentences.
sla_notes_details: Steps: choose two related ideas, choose the link words, put the clauses in order, and say the whole sentence with correct pauses. Patterns: 因为...所以...; 虽然...但是...; 如果...就...; 只要...就... (as long as ... then); 除了...以外,还... (besides ..., also ...). Dictation exercises help learners record sentences as models. Example: 除了英语以外,我还学习汉语。Chúle Yīngyǔ yǐwài, wǒ hái xuéxí Hànyǔ. (Besides English I also study Chinese.)
sla_notes_illustrations: Oral chain. A: 因为我想去中国,所以我学习汉语。Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó, suǒyǐ wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ. B: 如果你学习努力,你就能去。Rúguǒ nǐ xuéxí nǔlì, nǐ jiù néng qù.
sla_notes_daily_life: Complex sentences let learners give reasons, express conditions and discuss plans and opinions.
sla_exercise: Complete: 如果明天下雨,我们___在家学习。::就 (jiù).||Translate 除了汉语以外,我还学习英语。::Besides Chinese, I also study English.||Make a sentence using 因为...所以...::For example 因为我生病了,所以我没有去学校。

specific_competence_name: Develop the use of appropriate grammar and vocabulary in conversation and writing
learning_activity_name: Write complex sentences using different words
sla_name: Writing complex sentences with different words
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex sentences using different words are written.
sla_teaching_aids: Recorded texts with lists of vocabulary|Written materials
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write complex sentences with link words and a variety of vocabulary.
sla_notes_details: In writing, a comma separates the clauses of a complex sentence. Writing practice sheets, model sentences and error correction help. Common mistakes: using both 但是 and 可是 together, placing the time word after the verb (wrong: 我去学校昨天; correct: 我昨天去学校), and mixing measure words. Learners check word order, characters and punctuation. Example: 虽然汉字很难写,但是我喜欢学汉字。Suīrán Hànzì hěn nán xiě, dànshì wǒ xǐhuan xué Hànzì.
sla_notes_illustrations: Learner writes three complex sentences on studying Chinese: 因为汉语很有意思,所以我天天练习。 如果我努力学习,我就能进步。 虽然汉字很难,但是我不放弃。
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing complex sentences is a requirement for essays, emails and letters in Chinese.
sla_exercise: Correct the sentence: 我去学校昨天。::我昨天去学校。 (The time word goes before the verb.)||Translate 虽然汉字很难,但是我喜欢。::Although characters are difficult, I like them.||What separates the two clauses in written complex sentences?::A comma.

sla_name: Identifying the main ideas in a short oral presentation

sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to a short talk in Chinese and state its main ideas.
sla_notes_details: Strategies: listen for the topic sentence (usually first), note key words, notice sequence and link words, and ignore detail. Learners answer questions 主要说了什么? zhǔyào shuō le shénme? (what was mainly said?). Debate and field-trip presentations provide realistic talks. Example presentation: 我们参观了医院。首先,我们看了挂号处。然后,我们参观了药房。最后,医生介绍了他们的工作。 Main idea: a hospital visit and doctor's talk.
sla_notes_illustrations: After listening to a four-sentence talk on healthy habits (多吃蔬菜,多运动,早睡早起), the learner states the main idea in one sentence: 这段话说的是怎样保持健康。Zhè duàn huà shuō de shì zěnyàng bǎochí jiànkāng.
sla_notes_daily_life: Finding the main idea helps learners follow lectures, news and discussions.
sla_exercise: What does 主要 mean?::Main.||What is the topic sentence?::The sentence that gives the main idea, usually the first.||Translate 保持健康.::Keep healthy.

sla_method: Listen and retell and Rewrite what you hear
sla_assessment_criteria: Presentation are listened and its content are paraphrased.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to a presentation and say its content again in different words.
sla_notes_details: Paraphrase means expressing the same meaning with other words and structures: change the vocabulary (synonyms), change the structure (active to 把 sentences, reorder clauses), and shorten. Example: 我每天早上跑步 → 我天天早晨去跑步 (same meaning). Learners listen, jot key words, then retell without notes. Useful openers: 他的意思是... tā de yìsi shì ... (he means ...), 也就是说... yě jiù shì shuō ... (that is to say ...). Listening to Chinese audio at different speeds and identifying tones helps them keep the sense.
sla_notes_illustrations: Original: 医生说我应该多喝水,少吃油。 Paraphrase: 医生的意思是我要多喝水,不要吃太多油。Yīshēng de yìsi shì wǒ yào duō hē shuǐ, bú yào chī tài duō yóu.
sla_notes_daily_life: Paraphrasing is used to explain what someone said, confirm understanding and interpret.
sla_exercise: What does 也就是说 mean?::That is to say.||Paraphrase: 我很累 (I am tired) with a different structure.::For example 我觉得很累 (I feel very tired).||Why do learners note key words before paraphrasing?::They help recall the main content accurately.

sla_name: Summarising an oral presentation in writing
sla_method: Contextual learning and Rewrite what they hear
sla_assessment_criteria: Presentation are listened and a summary of its content are written.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to a presentation and write a short summary of its content.
sla_notes_details: Steps: listen and note key words; write an outline; write the summary in 3 to 5 sentences with sequence words (首先, 其次 qícì, 最后); avoid opinions; check characters and punctuation. Contextual learning: new words heard in the talk are recorded in context. The listener can also 'rewrite what they hear' after a second listening. Summary structure: who spoke, topic, main points, conclusion. Example: 王医生谈了怎样预防感冒。她说要多喝水,多运动,注意休息。
sla_notes_illustrations: After a talk on malaria prevention, the summary reads: 这个演讲的题目是预防疟疾。演讲者说要睡在蚊帐里,清除积水,生病时及时去医院。Zhège yǎnjiǎng de tímù shì yùfáng nüèjí. (The talk was about preventing malaria.)
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing summaries is needed for taking notes in lectures, meetings and interviews.
sla_exercise: What does 预防 mean?::To prevent.||Name two sequence words for a summary.::For example 首先 and 最后.||How long is a short summary?::Three to five sentences.

specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to read and understand various texts
learning_activity_name: Read a simple text and identify the intended message
sla_name: Reading a text and identifying the intended message
sla_assessment_criteria: A simple text is read and the intended message are identified.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read a simple text and identify what the author wants to say.
sla_notes_details: Read the title, the first and last sentences, then read the whole text. Ask: who is writing, to whom, and for what purpose (inform, advise, invite, warn)? Signal words: 请 (request), 应该 (advice), 不要 (warning), 欢迎 (invitation). Comprehension strategy: read for comprehension, underline the key sentence, and state the message in a sentence. Example: 请大家不要在医院里大声说话。Qǐng dàjiā bú yào zài yīyuàn lǐ dàshēng shuōhuà. Message: keep quiet in the hospital.
sla_notes_illustrations: Notice: 明天医院免费检查身体,欢迎大家参加。Míngtiān yīyuàn miǎnfèi jiǎnchá shēntǐ, huānyíng dàjiā cānjiā. Intended message: an invitation to a free medical check-up tomorrow.
sla_notes_daily_life: Understanding the intent behind a text prevents mistakes with notices, warnings and invitations.
sla_exercise: What does 不要 signal in a text?::A warning or prohibition (do not ...).||What does 免费 mean?::Free of charge.||Translate 欢迎大家参加。::Everyone is welcome to take part.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to read and understand various texts
learning_activity_name: Read a simple text and write a summary of its content
sla_name: Reading a text and writing a summary
sla_assessment_criteria: Summaries of simple texts are written.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read a simple text and write a summary of it in Chinese.
sla_notes_details: Method: read twice, underline key sentences, note each paragraph's main idea, write the summary in your own words (about one third of the original length), and do not copy sentences. Writing practice sheets help structure: introduction of topic, main points with 首先 / 其次 / 最后, and closing. Learners check that names, numbers and places are correct. Example text about a girl who volunteers at a clinic; summary: 小华每个周末在诊所做志愿者。她帮助病人挂号,还帮医生整理病历。
sla_notes_illustrations: After reading a 100-character text on a clinic, the learner writes: 这篇文章介绍了一家小诊所。诊所里有一位医生和两位护士。他们每天帮助很多病人。Zhè piān wénzhāng jièshào le yì jiā xiǎo zhěnsuǒ.
sla_notes_daily_life: Summaries are useful in reports, book reviews and notes for study.
sla_exercise: How long should a summary be compared with the original?::Much shorter, about one third.||What does 文章 mean?::Article, essay or passage.||Translate 这篇文章介绍了一家诊所。::This article introduces a clinic.

learning_activity_name: Listen and respond to complex orders in a hospital setting
sla_name: Responding to complex spoken orders in a hospital
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex orders in a hospital setting are listened and responded.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners listen to complex orders in a hospital setting and react correctly.
sla_notes_details: Typical hospital orders: 请先挂号,然后去二楼检查 qǐng xiān guàhào, ránhòu qù èr lóu jiǎnchá (register first, then go to the second floor for examination), 请把袖子卷起来 qǐng bǎ xiùzi juǎn qǐlai (please roll up your sleeve), 请张开嘴 qǐng zhāngkāi zuǐ (please open your mouth), 深呼吸 shēn hūxī (breathe deeply), 请在这里签字 qǐng zài zhèlǐ qiānzì (sign here), 饭后吃药 fàn hòu chī yào. Learners practise with role-play: one plays the medical worker, the other the patient, and react to spoken orders.
sla_notes_illustrations: Nurse: 请先坐下,把手伸出来,我给你量体温。Qǐng xiān zuòxià, bǎ shǒu shēn chūlai, wǒ gěi nǐ liáng tǐwēn. The patient sits, stretches out an arm and waits while the nurse takes their temperature.
sla_notes_daily_life: Understanding orders in hospitals is crucial for patient safety and for communication with Chinese doctors.
sla_exercise: Translate 请张开嘴。::Please open your mouth.||What does 量体温 mean?::To take one's temperature.||What does 签字 mean?::To sign.

learning_activity_name: Read different directions given in a hospital and react accordingly
sla_name: Reading directions in a hospital and reacting
sla_assessment_criteria: Different directions given in a hospital are read and reacted accordingly.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read signs and directions in a hospital and act on them.
sla_notes_details: Common hospital signs: 挂号处 (registration), 门诊 ménzhěn (outpatients), 急诊 jízhěn (emergency), 住院部 zhùyuànbù (inpatient department), 药房 (pharmacy), 收费处 shōufèi chù (cashier), 化验室 huàyànshì (laboratory), 洗手间 xǐshǒujiān (toilet), 请保持安静 (please keep quiet), 禁止吸烟 (no smoking). Directions: 往左 wǎng zuǒ (to the left), 往右 (to the right), 一直走 (go straight), 二楼 èr lóu (second floor). Learners plan a field trip to a hospital and read directions while walking the route.
sla_notes_illustrations: Sign: 药房在二楼,请往右走。Yàofáng zài èr lóu, qǐng wǎng yòu zǒu. Learner goes to the second floor and turns right to find the pharmacy.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading signs helps navigate hospitals, clinics and public buildings in Chinese-speaking environments.
sla_exercise: What does 急诊 mean?::Emergency department.||What is 一直走?::Go straight ahead.||Translate 请保持安静。::Please keep quiet.

main_competence_name: Demonstrate understanding of information in conversation and writing
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to read correctly various texts
learning_activity_name: Read accurately a simple text using standard speed, correct tone, pronunciation and punctuation marks
sla_name: Reading a simple text accurately with speed, tone and punctuation
sla_method: Reading aloud and Read for comprehension
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple text using standard speed, correct tone, pronunciation and punctuation marks are read accurately.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read a simple text aloud at a suitable speed, with correct pronunciation, tones and punctuation.
sla_notes_details: Steps: silent reading first; mark pauses and stress; read aloud with correct tones; check that tone changes are applied; adjust speed to be neither too slow nor too rushed (about 150 characters per minute is a good aim at this level); pay attention to punctuation (short pause at commas, longer at full stops, rising tone for questions). Read for comprehension afterwards by answering three questions on the text.
sla_notes_illustrations: Text: 医院在学校旁边。每天早上,很多病人去医院看病。医生和护士很忙,但是他们很热情。Yīyuàn zài xuéxiào pángbiān. Měitiān zǎoshang, hěn duō bìngrén qù yīyuàn kànbìng. The learner reads aloud with correct pauses and the second-tone rise on yuàn... and answers: 谁很热情?
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading with fluency and expression is essential for oral exams, public speaking and reading aloud to others.
sla_exercise: What should the voice do at a question mark?::Rise at the end of the question.||Why is silent reading done before reading aloud?::To understand the text and mark pauses before reading.||Translate 看病.::See a doctor (go for treatment).

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in a variety of contexts
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to communicate orally
learning_activity_name: Read aloud complex sentences in various contexts
sla_name: Reading complex sentences aloud in different contexts
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex sentences in various contexts are read aloud.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners read complex sentences aloud clearly in contexts like formal speeches, dialogues and announcements.
sla_notes_details: Different contexts need different tones of voice: a speech is formal, clear and paced; an announcement is loud and clear; a story is dramatic. Techniques: divide the sentence into meaningful chunks at commas and link words, stress the important word, keep tone changes, and breathe at punctuation. Learners listen to a model and react, and read text on cards representing hospital, market and school contexts. Example: 各位病人,请注意,医生现在开始叫号,请大家在候诊室耐心等待。Gèwèi bìngrén, qǐng zhùyì, yīshēng xiànzài kāishǐ jiàohào, qǐng dàjiā zài hòuzhěnshì nàixīn děngdài.
sla_notes_illustrations: The learner reads the announcement above using chunks: 各位病人, / 请注意, / 医生现在开始叫号, / 请大家在候诊室耐心等待。 and the class comments on loudness, clarity and tone.
sla_notes_daily_life: Reading aloud in various contexts helps learners speak in front of an audience and make announcements in Chinese.
sla_exercise: What does 请注意 mean?::Please pay attention.||Why is a long sentence read in chunks?::To keep meaning, tone and breathing under control.||What is 候诊室?::Waiting room (of a clinic).

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in a variety of contexts
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to communicate orally
learning_activity_name: Respond to compliments, apologies, wishes and sympathy messages in different contexts
sla_name: Responding to compliments, apologies, wishes and sympathy
sla_assessment_criteria: Compliments, apologies, wishes and sympathy messages in different contexts are responded to.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners respond politely to compliments, apologies, good wishes and messages of sympathy in different contexts.
sla_notes_details: Compliments: 你的汉语说得真好! Nǐ de Hànyǔ shuō de zhēn hǎo! Response: 哪里哪里,还差得远 nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, hái chà de yuǎn (not really, I still have a long way) or 谢谢夸奖 xièxie kuājiǎng. Apologies: 对不起 duìbuqǐ – 没关系 méi guānxi; 不好意思 bù hǎoyìsi – 没事 méishì. Wishes: 生日快乐 shēngrì kuàilè – 谢谢; 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè; 祝你成功 zhù nǐ chénggōng (I wish you success); 祝你早日康复 zhù nǐ zǎorì kāngfù (I hope you recover soon). Sympathy: 请节哀 qǐng jié'āi (please accept my condolences), 我很难过 wǒ hěn nánguò (I am very sad). Responses match the situation and the relationship, and contextual learning ties expressions to real events.
sla_notes_illustrations: Situations. A friend says 我考试考得很好! Response: 恭喜你! Gōngxǐ nǐ! (Congratulations!) A classmate steps on your foot: 对不起! Response: 没关系。A friend's grandmother has died: 请节哀。Response by friend: 谢谢你。
sla_notes_daily_life: Responding properly in social situations shows respect and builds relationships with Chinese speakers.
sla_exercise: What do you say in response to 对不起?::没关系 (méi guānxi).||Translate 祝你早日康复.::I hope you recover soon.||How do you say 'Congratulations' in Chinese?::恭喜 (gōngxǐ).

main_competence_name: Communicate effectively in a variety of contexts
specific_competence_name: Develop the ability to communicate accurately in writing in various contexts
learning_activity_name: Write short stories and conversations on familiar topics using appropriate punctuation marks
sla_assessment_criteria: Short stories and conversations on familiar topics using appropriate punctuation marks are written.
sla_teaching_aids: Downloaded video or audio from various sources that are relevant to learning contents
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners write short stories and conversations on familiar topics, using correct punctuation.
sla_notes_details: A story has characters, place, time, events and an ending. Conversations show speakers with a colon and quotation marks: 小明说:“你好!” In Chinese writing quotation marks are “ ” and the colon is ： . Steps: plan (mind map), write a draft, add link words and time words, punctuate dialogue, proofread. Active listening to a model story helps learners internalise structure. Gallery work lets classmates read and comment on each other's stories. Topics: a visit to the hospital, a day at the market, a school event.
sla_notes_illustrations: Conversation. 小华:“你好,医生。我头疼。”Xiǎohuá: “Nǐ hǎo, yīshēng. Wǒ tóu téng.” 医生:“你发烧吗?”Yīshēng: “Nǐ fāshāo ma?” 小华:“有一点儿。”Xiǎohuá: “Yǒu yìdiǎnr.” The learner adds a closing line and checks every mark.
sla_notes_daily_life: Writing stories and dialogues builds creativity and prepares learners to write scripts, diaries and messages.
sla_exercise: Which punctuation mark introduces a speaker's words in Chinese?::The colon ： followed by quotation marks “ ”.||What are the main parts of a story?::Characters, place, time, events and an ending.||Write 'The doctor said: Drink water.' in Chinese.::医生说:“多喝水。” (yīshēng shuō: “duō hē shuǐ”)

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and accurate translation of spoken and written language
learning_activity_name: Translate complex sentences
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex sentences are translated.
sla_teaching_aids: Translated documents|ICT tools used during translation
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners translate complex written sentences between Chinese and English (or Kiswahili) with accuracy.
sla_notes_details: Translation exercises begin with simple sentences and gradually increase in difficulty. Steps: read the source sentence twice; identify the link words and the main clause; translate clause by clause; rearrange for natural word order in the target language; proofread. Chinese modifiers precede nouns: 我昨天在医院见到的那位医生 wǒ zuótiān zài yīyuàn jiàn dào de nà wèi yīshēng means 'the doctor whom I met at the hospital yesterday', with the long modifier before the noun. Learners keep a glossary for medical and daily-life terms.
sla_notes_illustrations: Translate into English: 如果你觉得不舒服,就应该马上去医院。→ If you feel unwell, you should go to the hospital at once. Translate into Chinese: Because I was ill, I did not go to school. → 因为我生病了,所以没有去上学。
sla_notes_daily_life: Translation supports work in hospitals, schools, tourism and business with Chinese speakers.
sla_exercise: Translate: 如果你发烧,就要多喝水。::If you have a fever, you must drink plenty of water.||Where do modifiers go in Chinese noun phrases?::Before the noun they describe.||Translate: Although he is busy, he helps me.::虽然他很忙,但是他帮助我。

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and accurate translation of spoken and written language
learning_activity_name: Translate simple texts
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple texts are translated.
sla_teaching_aids: Translated documents|ICT tools used during translation
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners translate short simple texts in writing from Chinese to English or Kiswahili and the other way round.
sla_notes_details: For a short text, first understand the whole text; then translate each sentence; keep the register (formal or informal); use the correct forms for names, dates and numbers; and check meaning by back-translation. Translation exercises use short notices, invitations, or advertisements. Example text: 通知:明天下午三点在学校礼堂开会,请大家准时参加。→ Notice: A meeting will be held in the school hall at three o'clock tomorrow afternoon; everyone is asked to attend on time. Keywords: 通知 tōngzhī (notice), 礼堂 lǐtáng (hall), 准时 zhǔnshí (on time).
sla_notes_illustrations: Translate into Chinese: Please come to school at eight o'clock tomorrow. → 请明天八点来学校。Qǐng míngtiān bā diǎn lái xuéxiào.
sla_notes_daily_life: Translating short notices and messages is useful in schools, offices and tourism.
sla_exercise: What does 通知 mean?::Notice or announcement.||Translate 请准时参加。::Please attend on time.||What is back-translation?::Translating the result back into the original language to check the meaning.

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and correct interpretation
learning_activity_name: Interpret simple sentences
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple sentences are interpreted.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners interpret simple sentences orally between Chinese and English or Kiswahili, working in pairs.
sla_notes_details: Interpreting is oral translation. Consecutive interpreting: the speaker says a short sentence, pauses, and the interpreter conveys it in the other language. Skills: listen closely, remember, note key words, speak clearly. Field-trip settings (hospital, market, school) are used for practice. Vocabulary preparation is needed in advance, and interpreters speak in the first person: if the speaker says 我头疼, the interpreter says 'I have a headache'. Simple sentences: 你好吗? — How are you? 请坐 — Please sit down.
sla_notes_illustrations: Pair work. Speaker A (Chinese): 我想买一件衣服。Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn yīfu. Interpreter B: I want to buy a piece of clothing. Speaker A (English): How much is this? Interpreter B: 这个多少钱? Zhège duōshao qián?
sla_notes_daily_life: Interpreting helps learners assist tourists, investors and patients who do not share a language.
sla_exercise: Interpret into English: 请坐。::Please sit down.||Interpret into Chinese: How much is this?::这个多少钱? (zhège duōshao qián?)||In what person does an interpreter speak?::The first person, as if they were the speaker.

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and correct interpretation
learning_activity_name: Interpret complex sentences
sla_assessment_criteria: Complex sentences are interpreted.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners interpret complex sentences orally with accuracy and appropriate speed.
sla_notes_details: For long sentences the interpreter breaks the sentence into meaning units, notes key words and link words, and rebuilds the sentence in the target language in natural order. Smart devices (translation apps and recorders) can be used to practise and to self-check. Challenges: keeping numbers accurate, names, cultural expressions, and word order (time, place before verb in Chinese). Example: 虽然药很苦,但是你必须按时吃。→ Although the medicine is bitter, you must take it on time.
sla_notes_illustrations: A speaker says 因为路上堵车,所以我们晚了半个小时。 Interpreter: We were half an hour late because there was a traffic jam. The learner checks the numbers and meaning with a partner and a recording.
sla_notes_daily_life: Interpreting complex information is useful in meetings, hospitals, courts and business talks.
sla_exercise: Interpret into English: 你必须按时吃药。::You must take the medicine on time.||Why should numbers be checked carefully in interpreting?::A wrong number can change the meaning completely.||What is a translation app used for in practice?::To check meaning and to practise pronunciation and vocabulary.

specific_competence_name: Provide simple and correct interpretation
learning_activity_name: Interpret simple conversations
sla_assessment_criteria: Simple conversations are interpreted.
sla_references: TET(2023), CHINESE LANGUAGE SYLLABUS FOR ORDINARY SECONDARY EDUCATION, TET, DAR ES SALAAM
sla_notes_intro: Learners interpret a simple two-person conversation, switching between the languages.
sla_notes_details: In conversation interpreting the interpreter stands between two speakers and renders each turn. Steps: greet and explain the role, listen to each speaker, interpret in the first person, ask for clarification when needed (请再说一遍 qǐng zài shuō yí biàn), and stay neutral. Role-play with a Chinese speaker and a local person who do not share a language, with another learner as the interpreter. Field-trip settings give real practice.
sla_notes_illustrations: Scenario at a market. Chinese customer: 这条鱼多少钱? Seller (Kiswahili/English): It is five thousand shillings. Interpreter to the customer: 五千先令。Wǔqiān xiānlìng. Customer: 太贵了,四千行吗? Interpreter to the seller: It is too expensive; is four thousand fine?
sla_notes_daily_life: Interpreting conversations enables learners to help visitors and new business partners and can lead to careers in tourism and trade.
sla_exercise: What should an interpreter do if a speech is unclear?::Politely ask the speaker to repeat: 请再说一遍。||Interpret into English: 四千行吗?::Is four thousand OK?||Should an interpreter add personal opinions?::No, the interpreter must stay neutral and render only what is said.
